propositions: Eight top-level ticket directories in the tracker are empty, uncommitted, non-existent per rebar exists, hold no open file handles, and have mtimes older than 30 minutes, indicating debris from processes that died after mkdir but before writing the first event.
rebar fsck reports 8 MISSING_CREATE and 1 FOREIGN_STORE_PATH finding across these 8 stray directories, totaling 16 issues in the tracker baseline.

rebar tracker-maintenance --clean must guard the removal operation with an all-or-nothing equality check: the foreign path list at sweep time must be byte-equal to exactly the 8 triaged directories, else abort with no writes.

After executing rebar tracker-maintenance --clean with the equality guard satisfied, all 8 directories are removed, fsck reports 0 MISSING_CREATE and 0 FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings, and tracker HEAD and git status remain unchanged.
